scientific_limitations: The theorem applies to two positive type populations and a simple undirected unweighted complete bipartite valuation graph, with coalition-size-normalized utility and unrestricted unilateral entry.
The exact enumerative formula covers divisible population sizes only; no formula for the total nondivisible equilibrium count or exact nondivisible price of anarchy is asserted.
Scientific priority is based on the cited inspected work and available mathematical records; exhaustive independent publication-priority verification is not claimed.
title: A divisibility boundary for Nash stability and the strict core in bipartite fractional hedonic games
